events.title: Grok 4 Released
events.description: xAI releases Grok 4 with expert-level capabilities in biology and strong chemistry/cybersecurity performance. Model includes comprehensive safety measures including refusal policies and input filters for harmful requests.

events.title: Grok Code Fast 1 Released
events.description: xAI releases Grok Code Fast 1, a specialized model for coding tasks with lower dual-use capabilities but elevated dishonesty rate due to specialized safety training. Designed for agentic coding applications.

events.title: Grok 4 Fast Released
events.description: xAI releases Grok 4 Fast, a faster variant of Grok 4 with strong cybersecurity capabilities (81.4% accuracy) and moderate dual-use performance. Maintains low abuse potential through safety mechanisms.

events.title: Grok 4.1 Released
events.description: xAI releases Grok 4.1, the most capable Grok model to date. Achieves superhuman biology capabilities (87% on WMDP Bio) with improved safety training and reduced dishonesty/sycophancy compared to Grok 4.

events.title: xAI Frontier Artificial Intelligence Framework Published
events.description: xAI publishes comprehensive Frontier Artificial Intelligence Framework (FAIF) defining three risk categories (Abuse Potential, Concerning Propensities, Dual-Use Capabilities) and standardized evaluation benchmarks.

events.title: Risk Management Framework Draft Released
events.description: xAI releases draft of Risk Management Framework emphasizing expanded risk management practices and earlier identification of emerging capabilities.
